answer: The copper of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, diluted when peers disagree, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Every claim climbs the lotus of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the river re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short.
